intro: Lesson 15: Factors, multiples and primes. To understand how factors, multiples and primes are related

questions.model: Pairs: 1 × 48, 2 × 24, 3 × 16, 4 × 12, 6 × 8. 7 is not a factor; next would be 8, already listed.

questions.q: First three common multiples of 3 and 5.
(a) list the factors of 60 (b) list the common factors of 24 and 36 (c) find the primes between 50 and 70
Which numbers under 50 have exactly 3 factors? What do you notice?
Explain why every prime greater than 3 is one more or one less than a multiple of 6.
questions.a: Other numbers are 6n, 6n + 2, 6n + 3 or 6n + 4: all divisible by 2 or 3

questions.q: Big question: why is 1 not prime?
questions.a: It has only one factor, and a prime needs exactly two.
